metadata.description: Claude Code mods that make the terminal UI look like the Claude desktop app

plugins.name: desk-look
plugins.description: Claude Code mod that redraws the terminal transcript to look like the Code tab of the Claude desktop app: prompt bubbles, markdown tables, mermaid diagrams, folded tool calls, agent cards, plan card, GitHub/GitLab PR bar, diff and context panes

plugins.name: desk-asana
plugins.description: Your Asana tasks in a Claude Code side pane (/desk-asana): assigned tasks, workspace search, project tasks by section, details, comments, assignee, fields and status, through the Asana MCP server. Pairs with desk-look

plugins.name: desk-slack
plugins.description: The Slack DMs sent to you as conversations in a Claude Code side pane (/desk-slack): recent messages, replying and notifications, through the Slack MCP server. Pairs with desk-look
